services.desc: Course is now home to the only FootGolf course in Harford County. Our 9-hole course is perfect for any age and skill level. Anyone can play. Come out with your family and friends and try out this great game. What is FootGolf?FootGolf is a combination of soccer and golf. The rules and etiquette of FootGolf are similar to golf. The goal is to get the soccer ball in the FootGolf holes and complete to course with the least number of strokes. It’s a fun and inexpensive way to challenge your soccer skills.
